final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(account_count) AS total_count FROM district_counts), shares AS (SELECT d.district_id, d.account_count, 1.0 * d.account_count / t.total_count AS district_share FROM district_counts AS d JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(district_share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.district_id, s.account_count, s.district_share, s.district_share - a.avg_share AS share_difference FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.avg_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_difference IS NULL, share_difference DESC LIMIT 10
